# Ease Health — Style Reference

> Pine-green ink on unbleached linen, a herbarium page in three sage pressings. A light book serif, a warm off-white canvas, hairlines drawn in the same deep green as the type, and one cool slate tag for punctuation.

**Theme:** light

Values are measured from the live site and normalized; names, roles and recommendations are interpretation. Font lists are independent, not paired by position. Example prompts describe reconstructions, not the site's source code.

This is a single-pigment clinical-botanical language: forest green #0f3e17 does the work that black, grey and accent do on most SaaS sites. It sets 165 text elements, every filled button and every 1px border. The canvas is a warm linen #fffefc, and surfaces climb a tonal ladder of tints of that same green: #e1f4df, #cfe7d3, #b1dbb8. A desaturated slate #b6ced5, used 20 times, is the only cool counterweight. The chromatic budget is one hue at five values, plus one muted blue-grey that is permitted on eyebrow tags and the product-mockup panel. Typography pairs Faire Octave at weight 300 for every headline, from 40px to 74px with tracking between -0.01em and -0.03em, with Suisse Int'l 400 at 14px for UI. Size and serif-versus-sans carry hierarchy, never weight. Shape is a uniform 14px radius with no shadows, and depth comes only from tint shifts. The page reads as a printed care pamphlet rather than a software dashboard.

## Tokens — Colors

| Name | Value | Token | Role |
|---|---|---|---|
| Linen Canvas | `#fffefc` | `--color-linen-canvas` | Body background, the light eyebrow tag on sage, pill chips and the label on the oversized demo tile. It is a warm off-white (16 background uses) that keeps the green from turning clinical. |
| Mint Wash | `#e1f4df` | `--color-mint-wash` | First feature card and the rotating specialty panel. It is the palest step of the ladder (6 uses) and lifts content without any shadow. |
| Sprout Tint | `#cfe7d3` | `--color-sprout-tint` | Second feature card in the tonal trio only. It is the middle rung (2 uses) and exists to make the card sequence visibly progress. Do not use it as a section background. |
| Sage Field | `#b1dbb8` | `--color-sage-field` | Hero statement card, the full-bleed solution band and the third feature card. It is the loudest surface (5 uses) and marks the narrative turns. Do not promote it to a button fill. |
| Mist Panel | `#b6ced5` | `--color-mist-panel` | Eyebrow tags ("The problem", "Why Ease") and the hero product-mockup panel. It is the most-used background (20 uses) and the only cool note, acting as punctuation rather than decoration. |
| Graphite Nav | `#222222` | `--color-graphite-nav` | Top navigation link labels only (5 uses). It is a neutral near-black that keeps the menu quieter than the green headlines. Do not use it for body copy. |
| Forest Ink | `#0f3e17` | `--color-forest-ink` | All headlines, body text, primary button fills and 1px button borders (165+ text uses). It is the system's single pigment: ink, action and line in one value. |
| Paper Label | `#ffffff` | `--color-paper-label` | Text on compact forest-filled buttons only (5 uses). It gives pure white contrast on #0f3e17. Do not use it as a surface, because the canvas is #fffefc. |

## Tokens — Typography

### Faire Octave — light-weight book serif that carries every headline at a whisper · `--font-faire-octave`

- **Substitute:** Source Serif 4 at 350, Newsreader at 400 (text optical size), Literata at 350. Faire Octave Light draws heavier than its nominal 300. In the screenshots its stems look like a book weight, so a true 300 from these families would read too thin.
- **Weights:** 300
- **Sizes:** 25px, 40px, 56px, 74px
- **Line height:** 1.05, 1.2, 1.35
- **Letter spacing:** -0.25px at 25px, -0.4px at 40px, -1.7px at 56px, -2.2px at 74px
- **Role:** A single light weight across 89 elements is the signature. Headlines are large and calm, so they persuade by tone rather than by force, which is anti-convention for B2B health software that usually shouts in bold sans. Tracking tightens from -0.01em at 40px to -0.03em at 56px and 74px, closing the gaps a serif opens at display size. The 40px workhorse (82 uses) runs long, sentence-length copy, so this face behaves like editorial body text set large rather than like headline type.

### Suisseintl — neutral grotesk for every functional word · `--font-suisseintl`

- **Substitute:** Inter at 400 (Inter at 350 for the light stat figures), Geist at 400 (300 for stats), Hanken Grotesk at 400 (300 for stats). Suisse Int'l draws at true weight with a slightly narrower set than Inter, so keep these weights and do not step up to 500.
- **Weights:** 300, 400
- **Sizes:** 12px, 14px, 18px, 23px, 28px, 56px
- **Line height:** 1, 1.3, 1.5
- **Letter spacing:** 0px at 12px through 28px, -1.7px at 56px
- **Role:** Suisse handles buttons, navigation, tags, card copy and figures (89 uses), and it stays at 400 everywhere except the 56px stat numerals at 300. A medium or semibold weight would be the conventional move for UI. Its absence keeps the serif as the only voice with personality. Line height 1 on buttons and tags against 1.5 on running copy is the only typographic switch the sans makes.

### Type Scale

| Role | Family | Weight | Size | Line Height | Letter Spacing | Token |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| small | Suisseintl | 400 | 12px | 1.5 | 0px | `--text-small` |
| body-sm | Suisseintl | 400 | 14px | 1.5 | 0px | `--text-body-sm` |
| body | Suisseintl | 400 | 18px | 1.5 | 0px | `--text-body` |
| body-lg | Suisseintl | 400 | 23px | 1.5 | 0px | `--text-body-lg` |
| subheading | Faire Octave | 300 | 25px | 1.35 | -0.25px | `--text-subheading` |
| heading-sm | Suisseintl | 400 | 28px | 1.3 | 0px | `--text-heading-sm` |
| heading | Faire Octave | 300 | 40px | 1.35 | -0.4px | `--text-heading` |
| heading-lg | — | 300 | 56px | 1.2 | -1.7px | `--text-heading-lg` |
| display | Faire Octave | 300 | 74px | 1.05 | -2.2px | `--text-display` |

Every measured size is an 8px-grid design value rendered at 0.88× (14px = 16 × 0.88, 74px = 84 × 0.88). The steps from 14px to 18px to 23px run at roughly 1.28, close to a Major Third. The upper steps from 40px to 56px to 74px run at 1.4 and 1.32, which is steeper than a Perfect Fourth.

## Do's and Don'ts

### Do

- Set every headline in Faire Octave weight 300 from 40px to 74px. Weight is non-negotiable, because size and the serif carry the hierarchy.
- Use #0f3e17 for headlines, body text, button fills and 1px borders alike. One pigment across all four roles is the system.
- Round cards, buttons and image panels at 14px. The equal radius makes a button read as a small card.
- Build depth by stepping #fffefc to #e1f4df to #cfe7d3 to #b1dbb8. Tonal layering replaces shadow entirely.
- Space sections 140px apart and pad cards at 42px. The 7px-based rhythm needs room, or the light serif loses authority.
- Tighten display tracking to -2.2px at 74px and -1.7px at 56px. Light serifs open up at scale, and negative tracking re-knits the words.
- Reserve #b6ced5 for eyebrow tags and the mockup panel. One cool note per fold keeps the green ladder from going monotonous.

### Don't

- Don't bold a headline to 500 or 600 for emphasis. The thesis is quiet authority at weight 300, and a heavy serif turns the care pamphlet into an ad.
- Don't set body text in #222222 or pure #000000. Graphite #222222 belongs to nav links only, and a black paragraph breaks the single-pigment page.
- Don't add `box-shadow` to the 14px cards. A drop shadow on #e1f4df reads as a 2015 dashboard tile and contradicts the tint-only elevation.
- Don't introduce a second saturated hue such as a teal or coral CTA. The budget is one hue at five values plus #b6ced5, and a new colour fractures it.
- Don't convert primary buttons to 999px pills. The pill radius is rationed to non-interactive chips, so using it on actions erases that distinction.
- Don't fill a whole section with #cfe7d3. It is the middle rung of the card trio, and as a band it collapses the ladder.
- Don't use #ffffff as a page or card surface. The canvas is the warm #fffefc, and pure white beside it reads as a mismatched patch. Pure white should never leave the button label.

## Agent Prompt Guide

**Quick Color Reference**

- canvas: #fffefc (Linen Canvas)
- text: #0f3e17 (Forest Ink)
- nav text: #222222 (Graphite Nav)
- card surface: #e1f4df (Mint Wash)
- emphasis surface: #b1dbb8 (Sage Field)
- tag / cool accent: #b6ced5 (Mist Panel)
- primary action: #0f3e17 (filled action)

**Color in Data**

Charts use #0f3e17 for the primary series, with #b1dbb8, #cfe7d3 and #e1f4df as solid fills for secondary series, and #b6ced5 only to separate a contrasting category, so no data element ever outshouts a 40px serif headline.

**Example Component Prompts**

1. Build a Primary Action Button: an anchor with background #0f3e17, text #ffffff, border 1px solid #0f3e17 and border-radius 14px. Use padding 14px 21px, font-family Suisseintl (fallback Inter at 400) at 14px, weight 400, line-height 1, letter-spacing 0px and no box-shadow, with a rendered height of 44px. Label it "Book a Demo". On hover, change only the background to #b1dbb8 and the text to #0f3e17. Do not add a transition longer than 150ms, any icon, or a pill radius.

2. Build a hero section inside a 1450px max-width container on a #fffefc canvas, as a two-column grid with a 21px gap. In the left column, place a card with background #b1dbb8, radius 14px and 42px padding containing an h1 in Faire Octave (fallback Source Serif 4 at 350) at 74px, weight 300, line-height 1.05, letter-spacing -2.2px, color #0f3e17. Pin an 18px Suisseintl weight 400 paragraph at line-height 1.5 to the card bottom. Below the card, after a 21px gap, place a demo tile with background #0f3e17, radius 14px, 42px padding and text #fffefc at 14px Suisseintl weight 400, with a thin right arrow right-aligned. The right column is a full-height panel with background #b6ced5, radius 14px and a faded product screenshot at low opacity. Use no shadows anywhere.

3. Build a three-card feature row: three 370px-wide cards with a 21px gap, each with border-radius 14px, padding 42px, no border and no shadow. Set the backgrounds left to right to #e1f4df, #cfe7d3 and #b1dbb8. Each card holds a title in Suisseintl 28px weight 400 at line-height 1.3 in #0f3e17, then a 14px gap, then body copy in Suisseintl 14px weight 400 at line-height 1.5 in #0f3e17. Place a compact button (background #0f3e17, text #ffffff, radius 14px, padding 14px 21px) at the bottom of each card.

4. Build a static navigation bar on #fffefc with no background fill, border or shadow, inside a 1450px container. Put the wordmark on the left. Centre the links "About", "Case Studies", "Careers", "Resources ▾" and "What We Offer ▾" in Suisseintl 14px weight 400, line-height 1.5, color #222222, padding 7px 11px and a 35px height. Place one #0f3e17 button with #ffffff text, 14px radius and 14px 21px padding on the right, labelled "Book a Demo".

**Base unit:** 7px

**Density:** spacious

| Element | Value |
|---|---|

| buttons | 14px |
| images | 14px |

### Layout

- **Page max-width:** 1450px (1042–1450px)
- **Section gap:** 140px (70–140px)
- **Card padding:** 42px (21–42px)
- **Element gap:** 21px (7–28px)

## Components

### Primary Button — Forest Fill

**Role:** Compact demo and explore actions

A rationed solid slab. The spec is background #0f3e17, text #ffffff, a 1px solid #0f3e17 border, 14px radius, 14px 21px padding and a rendered height of 44–47px, in Suisseintl 14px weight 400 at line height 1 with no shadow. It appears as "Book a Demo" in the nav and as "Explore the EHR", "Explore CRM", "Explore Billing" and "Learn More". Most systems use a pill or a 6–8px radius here. The 14px radius matches the cards exactly, so the button reads as a small card rather than a separate control species.

### Request-a-Demo Tile (Secondary Action Format)

**Role:** Oversized conversion block, hero and footer

The button as a card. The spec is background #0f3e17, text #fffefc, no border, 14px radius, 42px padding and 122–136px height at widths of 635px to 857px, in Suisseintl 14px weight 400 at line height 1.5, with a thin white arrow right-aligned and no shadow. The site has no outlined or ghost button. Secondary hierarchy is carried by scale and placement instead of a second colour, which is deliberately anti-convention. Use this tile once per major fold, directly beneath a hero statement card.

### Navigation Bar — Static Text Row

**Role:** Logo, links, single action

A quiet rail. The bar is static, not sticky, and sits on #fffefc with no fill, border or shadow. The wordmark is on the left, centred links run in Suisseintl 14px weight 400 at line height 1.5 in #222222 with 7px 11px padding and a 35px link height, and dropdowns ("Resources", "What We Offer") carry small chevrons. The forest-filled "Book a Demo" button sits on the right. Using #222222 instead of the brand green on links is intentional, so the menu recedes behind the headline.

### Hero Statement Card — Sage

**Role:** Headline container, top of page

A coloured page within the page. The spec is background #b1dbb8, 14px radius, 42px padding and no border or shadow, holding a 74px Faire Octave weight 300 headline in #0f3e17 at line height 1.05 with -2.2px tracking ("Fewer clicks. More care."). An 18px Suisseintl supporting paragraph sits at the bottom of the card. Placing a hero headline inside a tinted card instead of on the open canvas is the system's opening statement that every surface is green.

### Product Mockup Panel — Mist

**Role:** Hero visual, faded product UI

A frosted window. The spec is background #b6ced5, 14px radius, no border and no shadow, filling the right two-thirds of the hero at the same height as the stacked sage card and demo tile, with product screens (EHR record, RCM figures) ghosted at low contrast inside. It is the only large cool surface on the page. Its desaturation lets the UI suggest itself without competing with the 74px serif. Colours inside the mockup are mockup-internal, not system tokens.

### Feature Card — Tonal Trio

**Role:** CRM, EHR, billing pillars

The main content card. The spec is a 370px by 382px card with 14px radius, 42px padding and no border or shadow, in three sibling backgrounds left to right: #e1f4df, #cfe7d3 and #b1dbb8. Each holds a #0f3e17 Suisseintl title at 28px weight 400 and body copy at 14px line height 1.5. The tint deepens across the row, so the trio reads as a gradient built from discrete swatches. That progression is the signature, and the step colours must stay in this order.

### Section Eyebrow Tag

**Role:** Labels narrative chapters

A small square-shouldered marker. The spec is Suisseintl 18px weight 400 at line height 1, #0f3e17 text, 11px padding, 7px radius and a 39px height. The background is #b6ced5 on the linen canvas, or #fffefc when the tag sits on the sage band. It labels "The problem", "The solution", "Why Ease" and "Broad clinical support". At 7px it carries half the card radius, so it is the system's smallest deliberate rounding and is read as a label rather than a button.

### Feature Pill Chip

**Role:** Inline benefit keywords

The system outlier. The spec is background #fffefc, #0f3e17 text, 999px radius, 9px 14px padding and a 32px height, in Suisseintl 14px weight 400 at line height 1 with no border ("Fewer clicks", "AI documentation"). It is the only fully rounded shape among 14px rectangles. That outlier is allowed because chips are non-interactive tokens floating on tinted surfaces, and the pill shape separates them from 14px buttons.

### Stat Figure

**Role:** Proof numbers beside headlines

Numerals in light sans. The figure is set in Suisseintl 56px weight 300 at line height 1 with -1.7px tracking in #0f3e17 ("$2.5B+", "11M+"), with a 12px Suisseintl weight 400 caption at line height 1.5 beneath. Pairs sit 42px apart with no card, rule or icon. Switching to the sans for numbers while keeping the serif's light weight lets data feel exact without breaking the hushed register.

### Specialty Ticker Panel — Mint

**Role:** Animated care-setting vocabulary

A slow typographic carousel. The panel uses background #e1f4df, 14px radius and generous 42px padding, with care settings centred in Faire Octave weight 300 at 40px with -0.4px tracking in #0f3e17 ("OTP", "Detox", "SUD", "Residential", "PHP"). The words cycle vertically and cross-fade. The panel turns a feature list into a typeset litany, which is the editorial alternative to the conventional icon grid.

### Problem Statement Block with Line Rules

**Role:** Long serif argument, decorative rules

Prose as headline. The block is Faire Octave 40px weight 300 at line height 1.35 with -0.4px tracking in #0f3e17, constrained to a 901px column and offset right of the page edge. A stack of seven horizontal #0f3e17 rules of uneven length bleeds in from the left viewport edge. The rules are the only illustration in this section, drawn in the type colour so that line and letterform share one pigment.

### Full-Bleed Section Band — Sage

**Role:** Marks "The solution" chapter

A chapter change by colour. The band is full-viewport-width #b1dbb8 with a 0px radius, 140px vertical padding and no border. A #fffefc eyebrow tag sits inside it above a 40px Faire Octave headline. It is the only unrounded coloured surface, and the straight edges are intentional, signalling a new chapter rather than a contained object.

### Logo Strip — Social Proof

**Role:** Customer credibility row

A single unboxed row. A 14px Suisseintl #0f3e17 caption ("Used by leading behavioral health organizations") is centred above eight customer logos at a uniform 35px height, spaced evenly across the content width, in their original colours with no tiles, borders or greyscale filter. Keeping the logos in native colour is anti-convention. The row is the only place outside colours enter, and it sits on open canvas, framed by space alone.

## Do's and Don'ts

### Do

- Set every headline in Faire Octave weight 300 from 40px to 74px. Weight is non-negotiable, because size and the serif carry the hierarchy.
- Use #0f3e17 for headlines, body text, button fills and 1px borders alike. One pigment across all four roles is the system.
- Round cards, buttons and image panels at 14px. The equal radius makes a button read as a small card.
- Build depth by stepping #fffefc to #e1f4df to #cfe7d3 to #b1dbb8. Tonal layering replaces shadow entirely.
- Space sections 140px apart and pad cards at 42px. The 7px-based rhythm needs room, or the light serif loses authority.
- Tighten display tracking to -2.2px at 74px and -1.7px at 56px. Light serifs open up at scale, and negative tracking re-knits the words.
- Reserve #b6ced5 for eyebrow tags and the mockup panel. One cool note per fold keeps the green ladder from going monotonous.

### Don't

- Don't bold a headline to 500 or 600 for emphasis. The thesis is quiet authority at weight 300, and a heavy serif turns the care pamphlet into an ad.
- Don't set body text in #222222 or pure #000000. Graphite #222222 belongs to nav links only, and a black paragraph breaks the single-pigment page.
- Don't add `box-shadow` to the 14px cards. A drop shadow on #e1f4df reads as a 2015 dashboard tile and contradicts the tint-only elevation.
- Don't introduce a second saturated hue such as a teal or coral CTA. The budget is one hue at five values plus #b6ced5, and a new colour fractures it.
- Don't convert primary buttons to 999px pills. The pill radius is rationed to non-interactive chips, so using it on actions erases that distinction.
- Don't fill a whole section with #cfe7d3. It is the middle rung of the card trio, and as a band it collapses the ladder.
- Don't use #ffffff as a page or card surface. The canvas is the warm #fffefc, and pure white beside it reads as a mismatched patch. Pure white should never leave the button label.

## Surfaces

| Level | Name | Value | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | Linen Canvas | `#fffefc` | Page background, open typographic sections |
| 1 | Mint Wash | `#e1f4df` | First-step cards, specialty ticker panel |
| 2 | Sage Field | `#b1dbb8` | Hero statement card, full-bleed solution band, third card |
| 3 | Mist Panel | `#b6ced5` | Product mockup panel, eyebrow tags |
| 4 | Forest Ink | `#0f3e17` | Inverted surface for buttons and the demo tile |

## Elevation

The system is shadowless: zero box-shadows were measured across the page. Elevation comes from tonal layering alone. A surface rises by moving one rung along the green ladder (#fffefc, #e1f4df, #b1dbb8), and the most emphatic surface inverts to #0f3e17. Borders are almost absent, apart from the 1px #0f3e17 ring that merges into the compact buttons' own fill. The UI feels like printed stock in varying dye strengths, flat and tactile like a coloured paper fold-out, rather than like stacked digital layers casting light.

## Imagery

Imagery is sparse and mostly typographic. The hero carries the only product screenshot, a ghosted composite of an EHR patient record and an RCM figure card washed into the #b6ced5 panel at low contrast. It sits inside a 14px-radius frame with no border and no shadow. There is no lifestyle or clinician photography in the opening folds. Illustration is reduced to line work: seven uneven horizontal #0f3e17 rules bleeding from the left edge, drawn in the same pigment as the type. Icons are minimal hairline glyphs, such as the thin arrow on the demo tile and the small chevrons in the nav. There are no gradients, glows or orbs. The narrative is software that gets out of the way, so care, not the interface, is the picture.

## Layout

Content sits in a 1450px container, with a 1042px inner column for card rows and a 901px column for long serif statements. Sections are separated by 140px on open linen. The hero is a two-column split: on the left a sage statement card stacked above the forest demo tile, and on the right the full-height mist mockup panel. Below it, a centred logo strip shows eight logos in one row. Sections alternate between open canvas, half-width tinted panels paired with text, and one full-bleed sage band. Feature cards run three across at 370px. The nav is static and transparent on #fffefc, with the wordmark left, centred links at a 35px link height, and "Book a Demo" right. The footer is a tall 829px closing block led by a second demo tile. At 375px, set the hero in heading at 40px, use 70px section gaps and stack every split to one column. The overall density is spacious.

## Agent Prompt Guide

**Quick Color Reference**

- canvas: #fffefc (Linen Canvas)
- text: #0f3e17 (Forest Ink)
- nav text: #222222 (Graphite Nav)
- card surface: #e1f4df (Mint Wash)
- emphasis surface: #b1dbb8 (Sage Field)
- tag / cool accent: #b6ced5 (Mist Panel)
- primary action: #0f3e17 (filled action)

**Color in Data**

Charts use #0f3e17 for the primary series, with #b1dbb8, #cfe7d3 and #e1f4df as solid fills for secondary series, and #b6ced5 only to separate a contrasting category, so no data element ever outshouts a 40px serif headline.

**Example Component Prompts**

1. Build a Primary Action Button: an anchor with background #0f3e17, text #ffffff, border 1px solid #0f3e17 and border-radius 14px. Use padding 14px 21px, font-family Suisseintl (fallback Inter at 400) at 14px, weight 400, line-height 1, letter-spacing 0px and no box-shadow, with a rendered height of 44px. Label it "Book a Demo". On hover, change only the background to #b1dbb8 and the text to #0f3e17. Do not add a transition longer than 150ms, any icon, or a pill radius.

2. Build a hero section inside a 1450px max-width container on a #fffefc canvas, as a two-column grid with a 21px gap. In the left column, place a card with background #b1dbb8, radius 14px and 42px padding containing an h1 in Faire Octave (fallback Source Serif 4 at 350) at 74px, weight 300, line-height 1.05, letter-spacing -2.2px, color #0f3e17. Pin an 18px Suisseintl weight 400 paragraph at line-height 1.5 to the card bottom. Below the card, after a 21px gap, place a demo tile with background #0f3e17, radius 14px, 42px padding and text #fffefc at 14px Suisseintl weight 400, with a thin right arrow right-aligned. The right column is a full-height panel with background #b6ced5, radius 14px and a faded product screenshot at low opacity. Use no shadows anywhere.

3. Build a three-card feature row: three 370px-wide cards with a 21px gap, each with border-radius 14px, padding 42px, no border and no shadow. Set the backgrounds left to right to #e1f4df, #cfe7d3 and #b1dbb8. Each card holds a title in Suisseintl 28px weight 400 at line-height 1.3 in #0f3e17, then a 14px gap, then body copy in Suisseintl 14px weight 400 at line-height 1.5 in #0f3e17. Place a compact button (background #0f3e17, text #ffffff, radius 14px, padding 14px 21px) at the bottom of each card.

4. Build a static navigation bar on #fffefc with no background fill, border or shadow, inside a 1450px container. Put the wordmark on the left. Centre the links "About", "Case Studies", "Careers", "Resources ▾" and "What We Offer ▾" in Suisseintl 14px weight 400, line-height 1.5, color #222222, padding 7px 11px and a 35px height. Place one #0f3e17 button with #ffffff text, 14px radius and 14px 21px padding on the right, labelled "Book a Demo".

## Single-Pigment Ink

The discipline is that #0f3e17 is the ink, the action colour and the line colour at once. Body text, headlines, 1px borders, button fills and the illustrative rules all share that one value. This breaks the moment a designer introduces a neutral grey for secondary text or a brighter green for links, because the page then has two inks and the printed-matter illusion fails. To extend the system, de-emphasise text through size (14px down to 12px) or through a tinted background behind it, not through a lighter text colour. Every new illustration, divider or icon should be drawn in #0f3e17 at 1px or more, never in a separate decorative hue.

## Light Serif Authority

Faire Octave appears only at weight 300, yet it runs from 25px to 74px and fills 82 elements at 40px with full sentences. Authority comes from scale and calm, not stroke weight. That is anti-convention for health-tech, where headlines usually go bold and condensed to signal capability. The discipline breaks if any heading is set at 500 or above, if tracking is left at 0 on the 56px and 74px sizes, or if the serif is pushed below 25px into UI duty. Extend it by writing longer statement headlines at the 40px heading role, with line-height 1.35 and -0.4px tracking. Hand all labels, numbers and controls to Suisseintl at 400, or at 300 for figures at 56px.

## Tonal Card Ladder

Elevation and emphasis are expressed as rungs of tint: #fffefc, #e1f4df, #cfe7d3, #b1dbb8, and finally the #0f3e17 inversion. The feature trio walks all three middle rungs left to right, so even a static row has direction. The ladder breaks if rungs are skipped arbitrarily, if a shadow is added to fake extra depth, or if a mid-rung such as #cfe7d3 becomes a page band and flattens the progression. To extend it, place new content cards on #e1f4df by default. Escalate to #b1dbb8 only for chapter-level emphasis, such as a hero card or solution band, and reserve the #0f3e17 inversion for the single conversion action in each fold.

## Similar Brands

- **Spring Health** — The closest category peer: behavioural-health software in soft sage tints with serif headlines, though Ease commits harder to a single dark-green ink with no secondary hue.
- **Lyra Health** — A shared mental-health positioning expressed through warm off-white canvases and calm, low-energy layouts, while Ease swaps Lyra's photography for type and tinted panels.
- **Attio** — A CRM that uses a light display serif for authority over a grotesk UI, the same two-family split Ease uses for its AI-native CRM pitch.
- **Mercury** — Shadowless tonal surfaces and light-weight headlines that persuade quietly, though Mercury's palette is cool neutral where Ease is green throughout.
- **Aesop** — One dominant ink colour on warm paper with a restrained editorial serif, the single-pigment discipline Ease translates into healthcare SaaS.
